content.playerFantasy: Crystal Bloom is an original global mobile single-player idle growth rpg that reinterprets the successful structural lessons of AFK Arena and Legend of Slime through a distinct setting, visual identity, progression mix, and touch-first presentation.
coreLoop: Heroes or characters fight automatically and continue generating useful idle or offline progression resources between active sessions.
Claim rewards, upgrade levels or skills, equip gear, and choose which hero or stat path receives the next investment.
Push a harder stage or boss with the improved roster, unlock another growth layer, and return later to collect the next idle reward cycle.
content.progressionDirection: Use sourced global mobile engagement and category-session evidence as a directional reference, while keeping the idle growth rpg core loop readable in short touch sessions and preserving longer-term progression between sessions.
content.visualDirection: The game features a distinct setting, visual identity, progression mix, and touch-first presentation.
